thread:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick check — co-hosted partner bootcamp @SiloCon on June 12. Need final speaker roster, who owns demo hardware, and a single swag custodian. Also VIP guest list for special passes.
Sam (Events): I can own the venue-side coordination. Who's on speaker list now?
Priya (Partnerships): Current: Jordan (Redwood runtime deep-dive), Tess (HW integration talk), ACME SI — maybe two folks (TBD). We need one backup speaker.
Jordan (Field Ops): I'll take the demo floor logistics. Need confirmation on how many demo kits we can bring and whether we can ship direct-to-venue or ship to SF office first.
Tess (HW Partnerships): HW kits = 4 full racks, 2 travel kits, plus spare power bricks. @shipping-bot can you confirm carrier options and ETA if shipped from our warehouse?
shipping-bot: Carrier rates returned: FedEx Ground 4-6 business days, UPS 3-5. Large crate surcharges apply. Request manifest by 2026-05-28 to meet venue deadline.
Lia (Marketing): Swag custody: I can own the swag pack and VIP lanyards. Will need count for VIPs and speakers by 2026-05-22. Also want a short speaker bio + headshot for the microsite.
Priya (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Confirm final speaker roster (owners: Priya/Jordan) — due 2026-05-18. 2) Shipping manifest to shipping-bot by 2026-05-28 (owner: Jordan). 3) Swag counts & VIP list by 2026-05-22 (owner: Lia). 4) Backup speaker assigned (owner: Sam) by 2026-05-20.
Sam (Events): I'll recruit a backup from Field Solutions. Prefer someone who can demo fallback flows.
Jordan (Field Ops): For demos we also need ephemeral API keys scoped to partner model variants. @Priya can you confirm who will request keys from Platform?
Priya (Partnerships): I'll file the request. Include these fields in the request: partner_name, demo_time_slot, model_variant, allowed_ips.
Tess (HW Partnerships): AV note — each rack needs: 1x 20A circuit, stage-run HDMI -> capture, and per-demo ethernet (DHCP ok). Also need power adapter list for international partners.
Sam (Events): Noted. I'll block for 2x 20A per rack and run two HDMI capture feeds.
Lia (Marketing): Run-of-show draft? 10:00 intro, 10:10 partner lightning, 10:30 deep-dive + live demo, 11:00 Q&A + customer drop-in. Need final times to sync with speakers.
Priya (Partnerships): Live demo segments must include fallback plan: if on-site HW fails, switch to cloud-hosted demo (same prompts). Add a prominent note in run-of-show.
Jordan (Field Ops): Agreed. Also tagging inventory with owner names to avoid mixups on site. Sample manifest snippet I will send to shipping-bot:
```
# manifest.csv
item,qty,owner,serial
rack-1,1,jordan,RK-2190
travel-kit-A,1,tess,TR-9001
swag-box-1,200,lia,SW-010
```
Jordan (Field Ops): shipping-bot — will upload full CSV by EOD Monday.
shipping-bot: Manifest uploaded and acknowledged. Carrier pre-booking pending until full dimensions provided.
Lia (Marketing): VIP passes: how many speaker + partner + exec invites? Suggest speakers (4) + partners (6) + execs (3) = 13. Can be adjusted.
Priya (Partnerships): That works. Lia please create a shared doc for bios/headshots and VIP names. Jordan — add owner column to manifest so Lia knows who to badge.
Sam (Events): Quick check on swag: any restricted items for international shipping? Tess, did partners ask for batteries or lithium items?
Tess (HW Partnerships): One travel kit has a Li-ion backup battery (air-shipping restricted). We'll mark that for ground-only and maybe carry-on with an engineer.
Jordan (Field Ops): Plan: battery kit will be hand-carried by Tess's engineer, crate will exclude that item. Shipping manifest will have a note: "battery-handcarry: yes".
Priya (Partnerships): OK. Final asks: everyone confirm their deliverable by the deadlines. I'll compile a single runbook and share Wednesday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
